verification_candidates.claim_text: Chronic stimulant use taxes the adrenal glands until they fail, producing a low-cortisol state and extreme fatigue.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: you're going to start taxing your adrenals to pump out more cortisol and eventually they will fail
verification_candidates.rationale: Specific causal chain from stimulant use to adrenal failure and fatigue; checkable against endocrinology evidence on adrenal function and stimulant use.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Regular stimulant use can make the body physically dependent on stimulants just to function normally day to day.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: your body is literally addicted to a stimulant to just get through your day
verification_candidates.rationale: Generalized dependency claim about stimulant medication users; checkable against pharmacology of stimulant tolerance and dependence.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Taking T3 thyroid hormone while cortisol is very low causes heart palpitations and anxiety.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: You actually get heart palpitations and anxiety when you add in T3.
verification_candidates.rationale: Specific adverse-effect claim about combining low cortisol with T3 supplementation; checkable against endocrinology literature.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Addison's disease is a rare autoimmune disorder in which the adrenal glands fail to produce enough cortisol.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Addison's is an actual disorder, a diagnosable disorder that occurs when the adrenal glands just they don't produce enough cortisol. And it's an autoimmune condition.
verification_candidates.rationale: Specific medical definition/classification claim about Addison's disease; checkable against endocrinology references.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Regularly consuming high-stimulant energy drinks like Red Bull, Monster, and Bang every day leads to negative health consequences over time.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: I guarantee you, you will pay that price.
verification_candidates.rationale: Absolute long-term-harm claim about daily energy drink consumption; checkable against evidence on chronic high caffeine/stimulant intake.

certainty_markers: I really can't speak to the validity of them
I've heard from both sides of the coin
verification_candidates.claim_text: Oral NAD supplements may not be absorbable or effective at raising NAD levels in the body.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: that you can't really absorb or make NAD from taking a supplement
verification_candidates.rationale: Claim about oral NAD supplement bioavailability directly bearing on whether such products work; checkable against pharmacokinetic research on NAD precursors.

verification_candidates.claim_text: There is no reliable way to directly test a person's ATP production.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: there's not really a way to test that, your ATP production
verification_candidates.rationale: Claim about the (un)diagnosability of ATP production, relevant to whether mitochondrial-function claims can be verified against a measurable marker.

verification_candidates.claim_text: NAD+ can be taken as an injectable peptide.

verification_candidates.rationale: Specific chemical-classification claim about NAD+ (which is a dinucleotide, not a peptide) and its injectable use; checkable against basic biochemistry.
